case.title: Malacca Strait Illegal Tanker Discharge (Benchmark Scenario Alpha)

metadata.notes: Synthetic benchmark scenario designed to validate attribution disambiguation among 4 distinct vessel behaviors.

supporting_evidence.title: Temporal Coincidence with Release Window
supporting_evidence.description: Vessel transit (23:05 UTC) occurred directly within the estimated release window (delta: 85 min from peak probability).

supporting_evidence.title: Open-Sea Deceleration / Loitering Anomaly
supporting_evidence.description: Vessel exhibited an abnormal open-ocean deceleration from 13.5 knots down to 8.0 knots during passage through the spill area.
supporting_evidence.threshold_used: Speed Drop >= 3.5 kts AND Min Speed < 9.0 kts

supporting_evidence.title: AIS Transponder Blackout During Release Window (1.5h)
supporting_evidence.description: AIS transponder was deactivated for 1.5 hours during transit directly across the estimated spill release envelope.

supporting_evidence.title: High-Risk Laden Crude / Product Tanker Profile
supporting_evidence.description: Vessel is an oil/chemical tanker carrying high-volume liquid hydrocarbon cargo and oily ballast.

contradicting_evidence.title: Divergent Spatial Clearance (24.9 km)
contradicting_evidence.description: Vessel trajectory maintained a 24.9 km spatial separation from the primary backward drift dispersion envelope.
contradicting_evidence.calculation_reference: Geodesic Haversine Distance to Origin Centroid

data_quality_items.title: AIS Trajectory Telemetry Density
data_quality_items.description: Trajectory reconstructed from 6 georeferenced AIS positions with geodesic waypoint interpolation at 15-minute resolution.

uncertainty_items.title: Origin Spatial Dispersion Uncertainty (1-Sigma)
uncertainty_items.description: Turbulent diffusion and hydrodynamic divergence define an origin uncertainty radius of +/- 0.50 km around the reconstructed centroid.

uncertainty_items.title: Release Time Uncertainty Window
uncertainty_items.description: Estimated discharge time window is bounded within 4.0 hours with a 90% confidence interval.
